properties.evidence: The older thought grown up. The 2026-08-06 PoC composed three designs in a LINE (dynograph-foundation -> reflow2 -> flo2) and proved the mechanism. This is the same idea with the second arm attached, so the shared upstream sits in the middle of a DIAMOND rather than at the end of a chain — which exercises something the line could not: whether the tooling can see two consumers of one dependency at all. Direction is deliberate: the PoC came first and this is its successor, not the reverse.
